columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Primary Key and unique identifier

columns.name: IS_TASK_CONFIG_SUPPORTED
columns.description: Flag to indicate if task config is supported

columns.name: IS_COMMUNICATION_NTF_SUPPORTED
columns.description: Flag to indicate that communication notification is supported or not

columns.name: USE_COMMUNICATION_APPROVAL
columns.description: Flag indicates whether to use HCM communication for approvals

columns.name: IS_AI_COMMENT_SUPPORTED
columns.description: Design time flag whether the process supports AI comments feature or not

columns.name: RESUBMIT_CALLBACK_CLASS
columns.description: The consumers can update the class in which a call back method will be written which is called at time of resubmit

columns.name: IS_RULE_SIMULATION_SUPPORTED
columns.description: Design time flag whether the process supports simulation feature or not

columns.name: ARCHIVE_PERIOD
columns.description: This column is used to store the Archival Period of the Process.

columns.name: RULE_CONFIGURE_MODE
columns.description: Will contain values null/External/BpmWorklist to identify which is the rule UI to be opened

columns.name: APPROVAL_OVERRIDE_SUPPORTED
columns.description: Design time flag whether the process supports administrator to provide override approval at any stage during the transaction life-cycle.

columns.name: IS_TXN_FRAMEWORK_PROCESS
columns.description: Design time flag whether the process supports approvals by leveraging the transaction framework.

columns.name: IS_COMMUNICATION_PROCESS
columns.description: Flag to indicate that process is specific to communication messages

columns.name: CONTEXT_PARAM_FETCH_CALLBACK
columns.description: Used to fetch parameter context

columns.name: RESOURCE_CONTEXT_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: This is FND Topology Module Short Name to get the context url of the Rest Service

columns.name: REST_RESOURCE_KEY
columns.description: Represent the Column Attribute Name of the HRC_TXN_HEADER Table to pass the value as Primary Key to the Additional Rest Resource

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_REST_RESOURCE
columns.description: Represents the additional Rest Resource Name

columns.name: CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Grouping of approval process based on specified category within the application family

columns.name: SUBCATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Grouping of approval process based on specified sub category within the application family and category combination.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CODE
columns.description: Grouping of approval process based on specified product code.

columns.name: FAMILY
columns.description: The Application family that owns the approval process.

columns.name: COMPOSITE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HRC_ARM_COMPOSITES

columns.name: TASK_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Task file name associated to the parent process and available at the source

columns.name: RULE_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Rule file name associated to the parent process and available at the source

columns.name: ACTIVE
columns.description: Flag to identify if the process is active or inactive

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description:
Identify the ENTERPRISE  to which the process belongs.  
Foreign key to PER_ENTERPRISES.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: TXN_MODULE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The Module that sets up the transaction business data for the process.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: BYPASS_SUPPORTED
columns.description: Design time flag whether the process supports bypassing approvals or not.

columns.name: ASYNC_BYPASS_SUPPORTED
columns.description: Used to identifiy which flow supports Async Bypass

columns.name: TXN_SUB_MODULE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The Sub Module that sets up the transaction business data for the process.

columns.name: IS_PARALLEL_TXN_SUPPORTED
columns.description: Design time flag whether the process supports Parallel Transactions.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
